reason: A browser UI plugin for DeepSeek Harness that adds a header control to cycle and persist conversation layout width presets across sessions and tabs.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面添加聊天宽度切换按钮，可调整对话区、输入框和用户消息气泡的宽度并记住选择。
summaries.en: Adds a DeepSeek Harness web interface control for cycling chat width presets across the conversation area, composer, and user message bubbles while remembering the selected width.

capabilities: Adds a conversation-header control to cycle chat width presets
Adjusts chat content, composer, and user-message layout widths in the browser
Stores the selected width in localStorage and synchronizes it across tabs
